notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 20, 2023
notes.content:
Today's update comes with fixes for several small bugs.

And we're making progress on some features requested by our players and testers, we hope to share these soon.

notes.title: Par for the Dungeon Available Now!
notes.content:
We're super exited to finally release the full game to Steam!  

We originally started working on Par for the Dungeon a little over a year ago.  The game we had been working on for over two years got a surprise cancellation, and after we had taken some time to regroup and get those creative energies going again we decided to dive into making a game for ourselves this time.

Par really allowed us a chance to express ourselves, and we hope the fun we had while making it comes across as you have your own fun with the game.

With Par's Steam launch complete, we'll be focusing on fixing the bugs reported and continuing towards its mobile release.  If you'd like to play the game on mobile, you can pre-register at the links below.  The reason we're doing pre-registration for mobile is so we can gradually release the game to more countries over time, this way we can find problems earlier and deliver the best experience we can.

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.SleepingGiantInteractive.ParfortheDungeon]Google Play[/url]

[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/par-for-the-dungeon/id1658597361]Apple App Store[/url]

We've also created a Discord Community where you can chat about all of our games, and share moments with the community! Come hang out and chat with other members, and we will be around as well!
[url=https://discord.gg/CYCBH5yg]https://discord.gg/CYCBH5yg[/url]

To celebrate the launch, our latest dev log is a look back at our favourite moments from the Par for the Dungeon dev logs.  Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=5_5P4N20ZtM;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you enjoy the game, and wish you the best of luck on your golfing adventures.

notes.title: Steam NextFest Demo Available Now
notes.content:
With this news comes a new update for the Demo.  We fixed some bugs and addressed some feedback from some early testers!

We're excited to share our game with you, and hope you have a good time playing it!

All of your progress in the Demo will be sync'd to Steam Cloud and carryforward to the full game.

If you have feedback or bugs to share, feel free to email us at support@sleepinggiantgames.com
